facts: Parties: Merrion Technologies Ltd (Buyer), Northgate Medical Ltd (Seller); the Company is Penrith Pharma plc.
This Agreement is dated 27 January 2027; Closing is scheduled for 23 March 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $6,500,000, capped at $3,000,000.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $5,000,000.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $8,600,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,600,000.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $4,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $148,180,000.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Ashcombe Technologies Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $3,400,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
